exam.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; basic technology and business vocabulary plus limited AWS exposure are helpful, and a controlled AWS sandbox supports the labs.

review.notes: The current official four-domain CLF-C02 guide, its domain pages, in-scope service list and certification page were reconciled on September 1, 2026. The guide maps every published domain to value, responsibility, identity, evidence, service-selection, availability, cost and support decisions. Three integrated scenarios, eight safe labs and 30 original checks cover Well-Architected and cloud adoption context; shared responsibility, IAM, governance, monitoring and data protection; global infrastructure and compute/storage/database/network/service-category choices; and pricing, allocation, budgeting, optimization and support. All 29 guide URLs are cataloged: 25 were reachable and two AWS decision-guide routes, O'Reilly and Udemy were automation-blocked; none was missing or broken. Service behavior, prices, support entitlements and training metadata are explicitly volatile, learning times are labeled, and no recalled exam questions are used. September 17, 2026 delivery maintenance: checked the live AWS certification page and added the applicable language retirement or replacement-exam notice, including conflicting vendor dates where present. Existing objective snapshot and full-review dates remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.
